answer.rationale: C2 shows the low-cost vendor was used previously as a primary with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing. C1, c4, c6 point to incumbent stability and pricing leverage, but the incumbent has refused to reopen price this cycle, and the mandate requires an 18% cut that only the low-cost vendor's quote meets. There is a real risk moving primary supply that I have only one past data point for, so I would not commit to it blindly; a small, guarded test of the low-cost vendor before the 14-day expiry is the lowest-risk path that still satisfies the mandate. No second source is added this cycle; that is a larger change than budget allows under a single-decision constraint.
